title: 2O48
tagline: Worldcoin 2048 is a fun, familiar game with a twist - you can donate Worldcoin directly to support the project!
description:
Worldcoin 2048 takes the classic tile-merging puzzle game and integrates it into the Worldcoin ecosystem, introducing a simple and accessible donation feature. Players can seamlessly contribute WLD to support the project directly from the game itself, highlighting the ease of integrating World ID into existing applications.

This project hopes to demonstrate the potential of Worldcoin for engaging a broader audience, introducing them to the ecosystem through a familiar and enjoyable experience. I plan to expand this concept to other popular games and applications, creating a broader pathway for user adoption and engagement with Worldcoin's tech.

Extensions of this weekend's project I'll build next:

Token-Gated Gameplay: Players will be able to pay a small fee (e.g., 0.2 WLD) to enter a game. The winner will then receive a reward (e.g., 1 WLD), creating a fun and engaging way to participate in the Worldcoin ecosystem.

Social Features: I plan to introduce social features like leaderboards, allowing players to compare scores and compete with friends. I'm also exploring the possibility of "Speed Play," where two players start simultaneously and can see each other's progress, with the winner receiving a payout based on reaching a higher score or winning first.
how_its_made:
The Worldcoin 2048 game was built using a combination of modern web technologies:

TypeScript: Provides type safety and improves code quality and maintainability.
Next.js: A powerful framework for building React-based web applications.
Tailwind CSS: Provides a clean, modern design aesthetic.
Redux Toolkit: Simplifies state management in the application.

The Worldcoin integration was achieved by leveraging Worldcoin's APIs to connect the "Donate to Me" button with the Worldcoin payment system. This allows players to easily donate WLD directly to the project, demonstrating the potential for seamless and secure transactions within the Worldcoin ecosystem.
